description: This file is a PHP source file defining a Smarty plugin function named {html_select_time}. The function generates HTML dropdown elements for selecting time (hours, minutes, seconds, meridian). It includes parameter parsing, dependencies on other Smarty plugin functions, and returns the HTML string for the time selection widgets.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_select_time
methods.description: Generates HTML dropdowns for time selection, with configurable options for hours, minutes, seconds, meridian, and their formatting.
